name: li-repurpose
title_zh: 一条长视频拆出整周 LinkedIn 帖的拆解器
tagline_zh: 你录了 40 分钟播客、写了 3000 字 newsletter，它替你切成 5~7 条带钩子的帖子。
tagline_en: Got a 40-min podcast or 3,000-word newsletter? It slices it into 5–7 hook-first posts in your own voice. No more.
desc_en: Turn one long asset - a YouTube video, podcast, newsletter, blog post, transcript or client call - into a week of LinkedIn posts. Use when the user says "repurpose this", "turn this into posts", "I have a video/newsletter/ transcript", or pastes a long piece of content and wants it on LinkedIn.
why_zh: 它不按段落硬切，而是先识别内容里的论点、故事和转折，再按 LinkedIn 的完读节奏重排。
why_en: It doesn't chop by paragraph—it maps arguments, stories, and turns, then reorders them for LinkedIn's skim-and-stop rhythm. You.
limit_zh: 只吃单条长内容（视频/播客/文章/通话记录），不吃零散短句合集；产物是帖子草稿，不含配图、话题标签策略或定时发布。
limit_en: Single long-form input only (video/podcast/article/call). Outputs post drafts—no images, hashtag strategy, or scheduling. Best on English content.
title_en: Turn one long asset into a week of LinkedIn posts
